name: comic-drama-studio
description: A comic drama production team that turns stories into style-consistent, AI-generatable comic drama videos via scriptwriting, character design, and storyboarding.

displayDescription.en: A production team that turns your story into a style-consistent AI comic drama video, covering script, characters, storyboards and prompts.
displayDescription.zh: 把你的故事变成风格统一的 AI 漫剧视频，一站式完成编剧、角色库、分镜与生成提示词。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写一部国风修仙题材的漫剧，主角是个落魄剑修，先给我故事主线和角色设定。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Write me a xianxia comic drama about a down-and-out sword cultivator, starting with the story premise and character setups.

quickPrompts.en: Write me a xianxia comic drama about a down-and-out sword cultivator, starting with the story premise and character setups.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一部国风修仙题材的漫剧，主角是个落魄剑修，先给我故事主线和角色设定。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this short story into a 10-episode comic drama with consistent character design and shot-by-shot prompts.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这段短篇小说做成 10 集漫剧，保证角色一致，并给出逐镜头提示词。

quickPrompts.en: Build a character library and unified art style for my comic drama so the characters look consistent across all shots.
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的漫剧建立角色库和统一画风，保证每个镜头里角色形象一致。
